headline: 1,938 iPhones seized: 6 Chinese nationals arrested in Cox's Bazar
summary: Police raided a hotel in Cox's Bazar, uncovering a massive stash of iPhones and laptops used for alleged online fraud.
details: Police arrested six Chinese nationals during a raid at Hotel Sea Palace in Cox's Bazar city. The operation uncovered 1,938 iPhones, 40 laptops, and various communication tools.

The arrests were made following a complaint filed at Ramu Police Station and based on intelligence provided by Dhaka police. The suspects were presented before the Cox's Bazar Amli Court and sent to jail.
According to police, the group is accused of operating an online fraud ring. They had reportedly rented two hotels along the Marine Drive road for at least two months.
The suspects are facing charges under the Cyber Security Act. Police officials stated that operations are ongoing to identify and arrest other individuals involved in the syndicate.

headline: Over 50 injured, one killed in Brahmanbaria clash
summary: A violent confrontation in Brahmanbaria has left one person dead and dozens more injured.
details: A violent clash in Brahmanbaria has resulted in one fatality and more than 50 people being injured.
The incident occurred as groups clashed, leading to widespread injuries and a death.
Local authorities are managing the situation following the outbreak of violence.
Further details regarding the cause of the clash and the identities of the victims are awaited.
